page.overview:
What is Aramadia?

Aramadia was an Imperial Super Star Destroyer used by the Duskhan League.

Like all Super Star Destroyers, the Aramadia was a wedge-shaped warship and at least several kilometers in length. The vessel was fitted with a secret slave circuit system that linked it to other Imperial ships captured by the Yevethans. When activated, the vessel's controls were overridden and the craft could be remotely controlled.

After Nil Spaar used the lead ship of the Aramadia-class on his diplomatic journey to Coruscant, one of the captured Black Fleet Super Star Destroyers was used during the Battle of N'zoth, going by this name as well.

The ship, along with the Pride of Yevetha and seven other Imperial vessels, was retaken by Imperial personnel led by Sil Sorannan when they rebelled against their Yevethan masters. After reaching the Deep Core, the vessel was seemingly abandoned by Sorannan and his forces.
